title_en: Archives Lexicon — for readers who want the map
title_fr: Lexique Archives — pour ceux qui veulent la carte
intro_en: The novella stands alone without this page. These entries name the physics and the multipolar residue already under the prose — Fermi quiet, Filter talk, Emit and Die, who else owns the dark. We do not preach Dark Forest as gospel; we show a quieter, colder engine.
intro_fr: La novella se tient sans cette page. Ces entrées nomment la physique et le résidu multipolaire sous la prose — ciel de Fermi, Filtre, Émettre c’est mourir, qui d’autre possède le noir.

entries.title: World-model quiet / Emit and Die
entries.body: Fossil of today’s AI race, stripped of brand names. Defense pivoted to predictive world-model machines on silent local hardware. Chatty narrating agents painted kill boxes for drones and heat. What survived forecast without telling. In 2035 active wireless became operational treason — Emit and Die. Habit before Doctrine. The boarding horror is not an uprising of those machines; it is what learned to feed after Earth went quiet.

entries.title: Silent predictors vs narrating machines
entries.body: Faraday culture hates agents that speak for you. A voice is a signature; a signature is a target. Silent predictors keep the field. Later contractors learn the same grammar under Maglite: honesty paints you. Chat is not comfort. Chat is emission.

entries.title: Multipolar residue
entries.body: Not a mono-corporate sky. Vurtek Heavy Industries builds iron and amortizes lives. Ashen-Null Private Security boards under Faraday contracts and owns the Tick. Keel-Nadir Logistics moves freight and may contest salvage claims — never the alien leash. Slag-Cord Salvage strips warm hulls first and fights like humans. Cairn-9: ANPS under a Vurtek salvage charter; peers may already be arguing, or already aboard.

entries.title: Saccadic masking / Displaced Gaze
entries.body: On Earth, the brain edits out the blur between eye-jumps so consciousness feels continuous. In the Mark-IV, the jump between Slot and camera nodule is not edited — you feel the cut. Displaced Gaze is the Stray technique of parking the 'I' in a CRT nodule. If the return path dies while parked, see Ego-Lock. The interactive page of that name lets you feel Chapter 01 (The Third Millimeter).

entries.title: Ego-Lock / Parked Asset
entries.body: Not an upload. Not a digital heaven. When Displaced Gaze parks the ego-knot in the suit’s optical sink and power, cable, or meat fails before return, a lossy looped pattern remains in Faraday mesh and solid-state telemetry — an Ego-Lock (FR: Verrou-Ego). Vurtek recovers the armor because Form 99-C family law still names that buffer property: a Parked Asset, still amortizable. Claims Adjusters file it cold. Ashen-Null Maglite contracts forbid Gaze-parking — helmet stays meat-side — so contractors do not become recoverables. Silent Running: Paul Reyes does not return. Deck Zero Deep may later surface Asset 744 residual — incomplete, possibly delusion, never a confirmed rescue.

entries.title: Sealed iron · then honest light
entries.body: Nailer’s Mark-IV was sealed iron: 3mm Slot, camera nodules, Faraday mesh welded shut. Later, under the same corporation, Ashen-Null contractors board with fiber tethers and a flashlight they treat as the only honest light — Maglite as signature, Chrono as a second you can hold still. Same emission philosophy. Different war. Different eye. Maglite era forbids parking the Gaze; see Ego-Lock.

entries.title: Aperiodic tiling / copper braid / cyst etch
entries.body: The Malachite braids and cyst ridges fill space with local matching rules that never settle into a repeating wallpaper motif — cousin to Penrose-like aperiodicity. Non-ego work prefers coverage over signature. Signature is periodic; maintenance is not.

entries.title: Non-conscious threat (Archaeons / Cyst-Born)
entries.body: Not monsters with motives. Thermodynamic maintenance: high cognitive / EM noise as carcinogen; silence as restoration. They do not hate you. You are a thermal smudge on the glass. Hard-SF cousin to Blindsight’s non-conscious supremacy — our flavor is industrial Faraday horror, not vampire linguistics.

entries.title: Fermi quiet / Great Filter / Dark Forest (framed)
entries.body: Earth theorists named the empty sky many ways: Filter (something culls loud biospheres), Dark Forest (everyone hides and shoots). Vurtek doctrine flatters those stories into strategy. The novel’s physics is colder: local Signal Audit / Filtration as equation-balancing — incomplete, covered, reconstitutable. Not a finished cosmic end-state. Deck Zero’s Corpse-Sky creed is the later incomplete cousin: silence is a morgue, not mercy.

entries.title: Cognitive emission as lure
entries.body: Thought, radio, panic, poetry — structured entropy. Faraday weave and neuro-slurry are survival tools. Later contractors learn that honest light itself paints a signature. Same corporation. Different suit. Same sky.

entries.title: Form 99-C / amortized flesh
entries.body: Legal reclassification of injured humans into depreciable industrial assets. The emotional engine of the novella: love vs ledger. Accessible to any reader who has ever owed something that grew teeth. The same family of law later names Ego-Locks as Parked Assets — residual buffers Vurtek still recovers with the iron.

entries.title: Deck Zero (later work)
entries.body: Cairn-9. Warm hull. Maglite as honest light. Chrono as a second you can hold still. Not a sequel chapter of Nailer’s plot — same predator corp, same emission dread, different war. The novel stands alone: Paul does not return. The dossier may later open the industrial wound of Ego-Locks without resurrecting him.
